g.text: Lower probability ← change in percentage points → higher probability
Native → one-gate ablation · percentage points · identical native prefixes
Gray “off” cells: gate inactive, so the intervention is an exact no-op.
12 fixed prompts × 5 separate gates; no joint ablation. Every greedy response is unchanged.
